title: Letlole la Mmuso
subtitle: Qeta mehato ya hao ya ho latela melao ho notlolla thuso e fihlang ho R300,000.
hero_title: Tsela ya hao ya ho tshwaneleha
hero_anchor: Tsela ya ho tshwaneleha e bonolo: qeta mehato ya hao ya ho latela melao. E nngwe le e nngwe eo o e phethang e o atametsa haufi le letlole.
hero_cta: Tswela pele ka mehato ya hao ya ho latela melao
hero_cta_done: Sheba mehato ya hao ya ho latela melao
status_green_title: O a tshwaneleha — mehato ya hao ya ho latela melao e entswe
status_green_desc: O qetile seo letlole le se hlokang. O ka fumana ho fihla ho R300,000 ka dimpho le dikadimo tse se nang phaello. Etsa kopo ka tlase.
status_amber_title: O batla o fihlile — mehato e {count} e setseng
status_amber_desc: Qeta mehato ya hao e setseng ya ho latela melao ho tshwaneleha. Ke kamoo o notlollang thuso e fihlang ho R300,000.
status_red_title: Qala ka mehato ya hao ya ho latela melao
status_red_desc: O na le mehato e {count} e setseng pele o ka etsa kopo. Ho qeta tsela ya hao ya ho latela melao ke kamoo o tshwanelehang — re tla o tsamaisa hara e nngwe le e nngwe.
eligibility_summary_blocked: O ka nna wa se tshwanelehe
eligibility_sa_citizen_hint: E behilwe nakong ya ho kena. Beng ba tswetsweng kantle ho naha ba fuweng boahi ba Afrika Borwa pele ho 1994 le bona ba a tshwaneleha.
eligibility_township_rural_hint: Letlole le tshehetsa feela mabenkele a dilokeishene kapa mahaeng.
eligibility_owner_managed_label: Ke laola lebenkele lena ka mafolofolo
eligibility_owner_managed_hint: Letlole le hloka mong'a lebenkele ho tsamaisa lebenkele letsatsi le letsatsi.
priority_subtitle: Beng ba bang ba fuwa tlhokomelo ha letlole le hlahloba dikopo. Movestock ha e boloke dikarabo tsa batjha kapa basadi — di tshwaye kopong ya hao ya SEDFA.
priority_disability_label: Motho ya nang le bokgoni bo fokolang
priority_disability_hint: Re bolelle haeba o phela le bokoma — ho fa kopo ya hao tlhokomelo.
priority_declared_hint: Ha o etsa kopo ho spazashopfund.co.za, tshwaya dihlopha tse tshwanang tse fuwang tlhokomelo hore SEDFA e tshwaye kopo ya hao.
eligibility_blocked_warning: Letlole le hloka hore lebenkele la hao le be lokeishene kapa mahaeng mme le laolwe ke mong'a lona. O ka nna wa se tshwanelehe.
eligibility_save_failed: Ha e a kgona ho boloka — ka kopo leka hape.
doc_cipc_conditional_hint: E hlokahala feela haeba o batla ho feta R80,000.
doc_sars_grace_hint: O kahara nako ya dikgwedi tse tsheletseng ya tshwarelo ya SARS — SARS ha e thibele kopo ya hao, empa ngodisa pele nako e kwala.
tier1_title: Mokga 1 — thuso e nyenyane (ho fihla ho R100,000)
tier1_stock_title: Mpho ya setoko: ho fihla ho R40,000
tier1_stock_desc: Bakeng sa ho reka setoko sa pele ka balekane ba amohelehang ba phano.
tier1_infra_desc: Bakeng sa disetsidifatsi, dishelefe, tshireletso, dintlafatso tsa moaho (motswako wa mpho le kadimo).
tier1_training_desc: Disistimi tsa POS, bokgoni ba kgwebo, tsebo ya dijithale, polokeho ya dijo.
tier1_cipc_unlock_hint: Ngodiso ya khampani (CIPC) e hlokahala bakeng sa thuso efe kapa efe e ka hodimo ho R80,000. Ngodisa ho notlolla Mokga wa 2 (ho fihla ho R300,000).
tier2_title: Mokga 2 — thuso e felletseng (ho fihla ho R300,000)
tier2_blended_title: Karolo mpho, karolo kadimo: ho fihla ho R250,000
tier2_blended_desc: 50% mpho (chelete ya mahala) + 50% kadimo e se nang phaello.
tier2_training_title: Koetliso e eketsehileng: ho fihla ho R100,000
tier2_training_desc: Tshehetso ya ho latela melao le ntshetsopele ya kgwebo.
pack_desc: Movestock e tla kopanya dintlha tsa kgwebo ya hao, boemo ba ngodiso, histori ya dithekiso le direkoto tsa ho latela melao ho PDF e le nngwe.
pack_missing_hint: Qeta ditokomane tse ding tse {count} pele. Sephutheloana se hloka dingodiso tsa hao tsohle.
pack_open_journey: Eya Leetong la ho Latela Melao
apply_portal_url_hint: spazashopfund.co.za (e tsamaiswa ke NEF molateng wa SEDFA).
apply_in_person_desc: Etela ofisi ya SEDFA e haufi le wena. Tlisa ditokomane tsa hao le ID.
sars_grace_countdown_title: Nako ya tshwarelo ya SARS: matsatsi a {days} a setseng
sars_grace_countdown_body: O ka etsa kopo ya letlole ntle le ngodiso ya SARS ho fihla ka {date}. Ngodisa pele ho moo — hang ha nako e kwala, o tla hloka SARS faeleng ho dula o itokiselitse.
apply_scam_warning_title: Hlokomela diforomo tsa bohata tsa letlole le bathusi
apply_scam_warning_body: SAnews e lemositse ka bathusi ba bohata ba rekisang 'diforomo tsa kopo' kapa ba ithaopang ho romella molateng wa hao. Kopo ya letlole ke MAHALA mme e fumaneha FEELA ka spazashopfund.co.za, NEF, le SEDFA. Le ka mohla o se ke wa lefa motho ho etsa kopo molateng wa hao.
tier_ladder_header: Mekga ya thuso — tekanyo ya R80,000
tier_ladder_below_hint: Ha ho ngodiso ya khampani (CIPC) e hlokahalang
tier_ladder_above_hint: Ngodiso ya khampani (CIPC) e a hlokahala (o na le dikgwedi tse 6 kamora tumello ho ngodisa)
tier_ladder_cap_hint: Ha e fumanehe — R300,000 ke tekanyo e phahameng ka lebenkele
